$comment: Anicca's discovery payload, shaped to the x402 Bazaar PaymentRequiredResponse schema (https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/blob/main/docs/extensions/bazaar.mdx). When the Coinbase x402 facilitator settles a first payment against any of these routes, the entries below will auto-populate the public catalog at https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources and become visible on https://agentic.market. There is no public REST endpoint for direct submission (probed 2026-06-03; agentic.market/api/* returns 404). Discovery is settlement-driven.

service.name: Anicca
service.tagline: Anicca's sovereign API services — pay USDC, get answers. No keys, no signup.

endpoints.description: Echoes the supplied text after USDC payment. Cheapest route — proves the loop.
Returns Anicca's FTS5-indexed lesson for a given topic (Wave 1 returns stub; full retrieval lands in Wave 2).

submission.research_2026_06_03: agentic.market has NO public REST submission API. The marketplace mirrors the Coinbase x402 facilitator catalog. To appear there, the endpoint must (a) emit a spec-compliant 402 PaymentRequiredResponse, (b) route settlement through a bazaar-compliant facilitator (Coinbase facilitator at api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/facilitator/*), (c) receive at least one settled payment. After that the resource is indexed automatically at /platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources.
submission.current_status: Endpoint is live + reachable; 402 response uses an Anicca-specific schema. To be Bazaar-compatible, server.ts must additionally emit the canonical `accepts[]` PaymentRequiredResponse shape — flagged as round-3 work in the round-2 report.
